candidates.violated_requirement: The Gray-to-binary conversion will produce incorrect binary values when bit 1 of the Gray code is 1 and bit 2 is 0, leading to wrong Gray code outputs in subsequent steps. This will be triggered after the counter reaches certain states where this condition occurs.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires correct Gray-to-binary conversion where each binary bit should be the XOR of the corresponding Gray bit and the more significant binary bit.
